description: Orangetheory Fitness is a health and fitness studio franchise headquartered in Boca Raton, Florida. The franchisor, OTF Franchisor, LLC, is a Delaware limited liability company formed in December 2018 and an indirect subsidiary of Purpose Brands Holdings, LLC since April 2024; the Orangetheory concept has been franchised since 2010 through its predecessor. Studios offer members access to cardio and strength equipment in the brand's signature orange-themed trade dress. Per the FDD issued March 31, 2026, the franchise fee is $59,950, total initial investment ranges from $764,577 to $1,104,920, royalties are 8% of gross sales plus a 3% brand fund contribution (risable to 5%), and territories are non-exclusive. Item 19 reports average gross sales of $802,145 across 1,189 franchised studios for the 12 months ended February 28, 2026. The system totaled 1,224 studios at the end of 2025 (1,209 franchised + 15 affiliate-owned), down from 1,333 at the end of 2023.
territoryDescription: Non-exclusive. The Franchise Agreement designates a protected Territory: as long as you are in compliance, the franchisor and affiliates will not operate or authorize Studios identified by the Marks with premises inside your Territory, except Limited Access Locations (hotels, hospitals, universities, military bases, offices, condos/dorms, private clubs). The franchisor reserves broad rights: studios under other names inside the Territory, studios under the Marks outside the Territory, other concepts anywhere, and acquiring/converting other businesses anywhere. Minimum performance standards: $300,000 (Year 1), $350,000 (Year 2), $400,000 (Year 3+) gross sales, with royalty true-up and possible territory reduction or termination after two consecutive misses.
item20_reconciliation: FDD Item 20 Table No. 1 (p.60): 1,224 studios as of 12/31/2025 (1,209 franchised + 15 affiliate-owned). The 15 pins below are FEATURED locations — the franchisor HQ plus real current franchisee studios from the FDD Exhibit H-1 List of Current Franchisees — not a complete map of all outlets.

financing_offered.value: No direct or indirect financing and no guarantees; arrangements exist with third-party equipment lenders — franchisor does not participate in underwriting or lending decisions

initial_training_duration.value: Four days — Initial Training Program, held quarterly at HQ in Boca Raton, Florida with some portions online via Orange University; up to three trainees at no charge

studio_launch_training.value: Studio Launch Training for up to eight fitness coaches and four sales associates (sales/operations and fitness programs)

ongoing_brand_fund.value: Brand Fund contributions (currently 3% of Gross Sales) fund advertising, marketing, operations support, and the technology platform

territory_exclusive.value: No — 'You will not receive an exclusive territory under either the Area Development Agreement or the Franchise Agreement.' The Franchise Agreement designates a 'Territory' (protected): as long as you are in compliance, the franchisor and affiliates will not operate or authorize Studios identified by the Marks with premises inside your Territory, except Limited Access Locations (hotels, hospitals, universities, military bases, offices, condos/dorms, private clubs, etc.)

territory_size.value: No minimum geographic or population size specified; determined by population, traffic flow, businesses, competitors, demographics; defined by boundaries/streets and inserted with a map in Schedule 1 to Appendix A

minimum_performance_standards.value: Year 1: $300,000 gross sales; Year 2: $350,000; Year 3+: $400,000 (non-cumulative). Shortfall in a year: pay the difference between Royalties actually paid and Royalties that would have been paid at the standard, plus an approved business plan. Two consecutive years missed: franchisor may reduce/eliminate Territory, terminate, or exercise other remedies

franchisor_reserved_rights.value: Franchisor/affiliates reserve: operate/license studios under the Marks outside the Territory or under other names anywhere (incl. inside the Territory); develop other concepts anywhere; acquire/merge with other businesses anywhere and convert them to the ORANGETHEORY brand even inside the Territory

territory_relocation.value: Studio must operate only at the accepted location; no relocation without prior written consent and conditions

site_selection_deadline.value: Must select and secure an accepted site within the non-exclusive Site Selection Area within four months of the Franchise Agreement effective date

trademark_rights.value: Right to operate under the Marks (ORANGETHEORY, OT FIT, OTF and related) per the franchise agreement

owner_operator_required.value: Not required — personal supervision by you or your Principal Owner is recommended, not required; must designate a full-time on-premises manager who has completed management training

sell_restrictions.value: Must offer the products/services the franchisor specifies for the Studio; system standards govern

risk_score.item: THEORETICAL — method: base 20 +8 system contraction (1,333 total studios at end-2023 -> 1,224 at end-2025; franchised 1,311 -> 1,209, net -102) +8 high closure/exit volume (95 permanent closures in Item 19 period; 362 franchisees on the H-2 left-the-system list) +10 capital intensity (investment ceiling $1,104,920) +8 ongoing fee burden (royalty 8% + brand fund 3% rising to 5% + local ad minimum 2% or $2,500/mo = 13-15% of gross sales) +2 technology fee $899/mo with 10% compounded annual increases +6 non-exclusive territory with franchisor reserved rights (other-name studios inside Territory, acquired-business conversion) +5 minimum performance standards ($300K/$350K/$400K with royalty true-up; two consecutive misses can trigger territory reduction or termination) +4 disclosed litigation (1 franchisee AAA matter, Item 3) +2 Item 4 bankruptcy history (parent CEO's prior company CEC Chapter 11 in 2020) -8 Item 19 strength (1,189 studios, avg gross sales $802,145, 44% met/exceeded average, avg 444 members) -2 audited financials attached (Exhibit D) -3 Purpose Brands/SEB parent platform backing = 60/100
